messages:
oliver: Heads-up — eu-west GPU pools saturated this morning, customers reported a burst of 429s across multiple endpoints. We have a bunch of logs with a new header pattern: `X-RW-Admission: full;queue=78;eta_ms=4200`

priya: saw that too. Oncall alerted at 09:12. Load was from diagonal batch jobs + sudden qps from a PLG customer. Pools filled in ~2m.

jason: Are we sending any client-friendly hints besides Retry-After? Customers' SDKs just do fixed exponential backoff which is burning tokens.

maya: we added an experimental "queue-depth" hint last month. It currently emits: `X-RW-Queue-Depth: 78` and `X-RW-Admission: queued;window_ms=5000` for queued requests. Not wired into docs yet.

capacity-bot: cpu/gpu util snapshot: eu-west-1a: 99%, eu-west-1b: 97%. Autoscale cooldown hit, can't spin new nodes because images still initializing.

sam: can the SDK use those headers to do smarter retries? e.g., scale back client concurrency based on queue depth and ETA instead of naive jittered retries.

jason: yes — proposal: SDK reads X-RW-Admission and X-RW-Queue-Depth and applies adaptive backoff. Pseudocode we discussed in eng-runtime:```python
# on 429 or X-RW-Admission present
hdr = response.headers.get('X-RW-Admission', '')
queue = int(response.headers.get('X-RW-Queue-Depth', '0'))
eta = int(response.headers.get('X-RW-ETA-MS', '0'))
# base wait proportional to queue position but capped
wait_ms = min(max(eta, 200), 10000) * (1 + queue/50.0)
# add jitter
wait_ms = wait_ms * (0.75 + random.random()*0.5)
await sleep(wait_ms/1000.0)
# reduce concurrency token bucket by 1 on each 429 to avoid stampeding
```

devex-bot: note for SDK release notes: include header names and an opt-in flag. default behavior should remain conservative so we don't change app semantics unexpectedly.

maya: infra note — we can emit a more precise `X-RW-Queue-ETA-MS` computed from current avg service time * queue depth. but it will be noisy during warmups. also can emit `X-RW-Admit-Window` to indicate token bucket refill rate.

priya: ops suggestion — for bursty PLG signups, enable short-lived prewarming in region (30m reserve) for accounts > X qps. helps avoid image-init delay. cost trade-off though.

oliver: action items: (1) eng-platform + sdk to prototype adaptive backoff using X-RW-Admission/X-RW-Queue-Depth (jason + sam), (2) infra to add X-RW-ETA-MS and X-RW-Admit-Window flags to admission response (maya), (3) ops to evaluate regional prewarm policy and cost (priya). I'll open a follow-up doc.

jason: will spike a minimal SDK change that is opt-in behind an env var; keep telemetry so we can see reduced retry floods.

maya: will add headers as optional feature flag in admission service; default off for 24h while we test.

priya: thanks — we'll monitor errors and customer-impact alerting. if we still see >50% request failures while admission=queued, escalate to emergency scale.

oliver: thanks team — thx for quick sync.
